notes:
Summary / working notes:
- Use-case: SaaS KB RAG for multi-tenant support product. Primary flow: query -> embeddings lookup -> top-150 candidates -> rerank with contextual score -> present top 5 answers.
- Scale: target index size 1–3M canonical docs (articles, transcripts, code snippets), metadata per doc ~2–6 fields.
- QPS/latency: expect sustained 6k QPS during business hours, peak 8k. SLA target: p50 <120ms, p95 <300ms. Observability needed per-route token/cost breakdown.
- Cost sensitivity: looking for cost/query < $0.001 (hosted) as threshold for approval; wants hosted TCO vs dedicated 3-node example.
- Model preferences: open models for embeddings (512-d) + smaller encoder for reranker; would like Redwood recommendations for quantized variants and batching settings.
- Routing/fallback: prefer hosted API with region routing; fallback to smaller cheaper variant if capacity constrained.
- Security/compliance: SSO (SAML), audit logs, KMS integration, data residency in NA required for some customers. Will accept public_cloud but need assurances on residency and retention controls.
- POC success metrics: throughput at target QPS with p50/p95 latency within agreed bands, cost per query estimate, end-to-end rerank accuracy and error-rate.
- Customer quote: "If we can keep latency under 120ms and cost predictable, we can replace our current hybrid stack."
- Practical blockers: internal procurement window (mid-April), SOC2 mapping requested, legal to confirm residency SLA.
- Action items for AE/SE: provide detailed hosted vs dedicated cost model, load-test script template, recommend embedding dim and index config, share security FAQ answers (drive link).
- References: pricing doc draft in Drive, security FAQ answered partially; Jira tickets opened for infra questions.
